title: [YSQL] Insert query is consistently crashing after alter DROP and ADD back the foreign keys with certain steps
body:
Jira Link: [DB-16152](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-16152)
### Description

Test doing lot of steps before this issue is happening , but still suspect this ALTER TABLE  might have something to do with it .Since the FK before dropping is also the same and inserts went through before the alter. - [Jenkins run](https://jenkins.dev.yugabyte.com/job/itest-system-developer/19364/testReport/(root)/TestFKonPartitionedTables/testfkonpartitionedtables_aws_rf3_geo_partition_enable_encryption/)
Before dropping ,
```
Foreign-key constraints:
    "fk_transactions" FOREIGN KEY (account_id, geo_partition) REFERENCES user_analytics_list(id, geo_partition) MATCH FULL ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
    "fk_updel_range_transactions_new" FOREIGN KEY (new_col, age) REFERENCES range_table(name, age) MATCH FULL ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE
```
After add back, Just adding back with the DEFERRABLE
```
Foreign-key constraints:
    "fk_transactions" FOREIGN KEY (account_id, geo_partition) REFERENCES user_analytics_list(id, geo_partition) MATCH FULL ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
    "fk_updel_range_transactions" FOREIGN KEY (new_col, age) REFERENCES range_table(name, age) MATCH FULL ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
```
